definitions.explanation: an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid

examples.japanese: {肺炎|はいえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こじらせて→こじらせる：22115_kojiraseru⟧{肺炎|はいえん}になった。
⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肺炎|はいえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Elderly people need to be careful of pneumonia.

notes:
{肺炎|はいえん} is the general term for pneumonia — an infection that inflames the air sacs in the lungs.

FORMS:
⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧ (lung) + {炎|えん} (inflammation). The ～{炎|えん} suffix is used for many inflammatory conditions: ⟦{胃炎|いえん}→胃炎：25491_ien⟧ (gastritis), ⟦{関節炎|かんせつえん}→関節炎：08445_kansetsuen⟧ (arthritis), ⟦{気管支炎|きかんしえん}→気管支炎：27056_kikanshien⟧ (bronchitis).

TYPES:
- {細菌性|さいきんせい}{肺炎|はいえん}: bacterial pneumonia
- ⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{肺炎|はいえん}: viral pneumonia
- {誤嚥性|ごえんせい}{肺炎|はいえん}: aspiration pneumonia
- {間質性|かんしつせい}{肺炎|はいえん}: interstitial pneumonia

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肺炎|はいえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to catch pneumonia
- {肺炎|はいえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}する→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧: to be hospitalized with pneumonia
- {肺炎|はいえん}⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧: pneumonia vaccine
- {肺炎球菌|はいえんきゅうきん}: pneumococcus

USAGE:
{肺炎|はいえん} is one of the leading causes of death among elderly people in Japan. {誤嚥性|ごえんせい}{肺炎|はいえん} (aspiration pneumonia) is especially common in the elderly.
